paragraphs: The Sprinter 413–519 CDI represents the higher-output end of the NCV3-generation Sprinter range, produced from 2006 to 2018. It was available with two distinct diesel engines: the OM651 2.1-litre four-cylinder for lower-output variants (up to around 413/416 badging) and the OM642 3.0-litre V6 for the higher-output 519 models. These are different engine families with different component sets and different known wear patterns — which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SPRINTER 413–519 CDI on the road.

cards.body: A 2.1-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Sprinter 413–519 CDI across the NCV3 generation (2006–2018). Known for injector seal leaks and timing chain wear — a well-established pattern across the wider Mercedes commercial vehicle range. We replace timing chain components and injector seals as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

A 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to the Sprinter 413–519 CDI across the NCV3 generation (2006–2018), typically in higher-output variants. Known for swirl flap and injector wear — a pattern well-documented across other Mercedes applications with this engine. We replace swirl flaps, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the Sprinter 413–519 CDI spans two distinct engines under one badge, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an OM651 part will work on an OM642 van — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Sprinter quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
